d:
Pour your coffee down the sink because you no longer need caffeine. Instant Mood Boost is a two hour mix for when you need an uplift. When you're having trouble getting out of bed or you need a second wind halfway through your work day. A spiritual sequel to 2024's Instant Energy Boost, our latest mix is sure to put some pep in your step and add some groove to your mood. When you hear some of the featured synths, when you register the hard-hitting drums, it's quite all right to get on your feet and move like you just chugged two energy drinks.
Listen to Chillhop on Spotify & Apple Music
